assistant.mayShareValues: May I send sample values of {{integration}} ({{path}}) along for this one draft?
assistant.valuesLeave: They go to the provider. Values can hold names, addresses or other private details.
assistant.valuesStay: They stay on the home network.
assistant.deniedValues: No values go along. I draft the card from field names and types only.
assistant.allowedValuesFollowUp: Yes, you may send sample values of {{integration}} for this draft.

draft.sentValues: Sample values of the service went along, because you allowed it for this request.
draft.sentNoValues: Only field names and types of the service went to the provider, no values.
draft.keeps: The draft stays as long as this conversation, {{days}} days at most. Nothing is saved before you save it in the editor.

assistant.hello: What do you want to know?
assistant.helloHelp: I read the state of your cards, the chronicle and the outages. I never press a button myself; I show it to you.
assistant.question: Question
assistant.refused: The provider declined to answer this. Try putting it differently.

privacy.anthropic: Questions and what nexdeck looks up go to Anthropic. The keys and passwords of your connections never do.
privacy.out: Questions and what nexdeck looks up leave the house. The keys and passwords of your connections never do.

assistant.notSetHelp: Under System, Assistant you choose Claude or a service in the OpenAI form, such as Ollama on the home network. It is off by default, and only administrators see it.
assistant.mayReadLog: May I read the last lines of the log of {{container}}?
assistant.logLeaves: They go to the provider. Log lines can hold addresses, names or tokens.
assistant.logStays: They stay on the home network.
assistant.denied: Not read. Without the log I only see that something happens, not why.
assistant.reallySure: Really? This cannot be undone from here.
assistant.ran: Done: {{message}} The log notes it was pressed in the chat.
assistant.keep: Conversations are kept for {{days}} days after their last question, then they are gone.
assistant.forgetAllBody: Every conversation of yours goes, and cannot be brought back.

error.off: The assistant is not set up any more. An administrator can switch it on under System.
error.auth: The provider refused the key. Check it under System, Assistant.
error.rate_limited: The provider is busy or the account's limit is reached. Try again in a minute.
error.unreachable: The provider could not be reached.
error.model: The provider does not know this model or address.
error.provider: The provider answered with an error.
error.no_list: This service lists no models; type the name of the model.

assistant.title: Ask nexdeck
assistant.help: A chat next to the bell that answers from your cards, the chronicle and the outages, and puts buttons in front of you instead of pressing them. For administrators only.
assistant.addressHelp: Up to /v1, for example http://ollama:11434/v1 or https://api.openai.com/v1.
assistant.modelHelpClaude: Sonnet is enough for the chat and costs a fraction of Opus. Empty takes claude-sonnet-5-5.
assistant.modelHelpOpenai: Load the list, or type the name. The model must be able to call tools, for example qwen3 or llama3.1.
assistant.keyHelpOpenai: Ollama and LM Studio need none.
assistant.keyKept: A key is stored; type a new one to replace it
assistant.leaves: Questions, and what nexdeck looks up to answer them, leave the house: card states, chronicle lines, and log lines once you allow them. The keys and passwords of your connections never do.
assistant.stays: This address is on the home network: questions and what nexdeck looks up stay in the house.
assistant.unknown: Once saved, this says whether the address is on the home network.
assistant.who: Only administrators see the chat. Conversations are kept for 30 days. The assistant never presses a button: it shows it, with what it would hit, and you press it.
assistant.testCosts: The test asks one short question and costs a few tokens.
